regions.full_page:
God bless you this blessed day of the Lord, - you and yours. Many
thanks for your kind favor of several weeks back. I started a number of
times to acknowledge same. I hope my laziness may not scandalize.

Not only this favor, however, do I want to thank you, but more I want
to assure you of our appreciation of your generous activity these several
years in the really privileged, though not less arduous work of the holy
foreign missions. I am sure that the Good God will bless - has blessed -
you in many ways for your practical interest in this outstanding phase of
really Catholic action.

Besides this, I want to congratulate you on your having been so
guided as to be able to write of a business associate as you do of the
young man with whom you condole on the death of his amiable mother. It
is always a relief to know of such a person. The very fact of his having
been a "bible student" ought to spell something in his favor. This, even
though, for want of proper guidance, many a "bible student" has anchored
in dangerous waters.

But these days when atheism, the very climax of intellectual stupidity,
of moral insanity, of diabolically devilish perversity; it is a hopeful
indication to see anyone of good will taking more than ordinary interest in
the divine messages from Heaven as are those conveyed to humanity through
the inspired writings, the divinely guided compilation and the appreciative,
prayerful study of the Holy Bible. This all the more now, that in the
family of governments one of even the "big powers" is not only permitted to
show its shamelessly criminal face, but brazenly to insist on dictating
hell's own principles of peace. Indeed an unmistakable indication whither
our godless system of public-education is, not only tending but tumbling;
unless by an effective S.O.S. call of true religion. Pardon my digression.

I would have enrolled your friend-associate as also his deceased
mother, but I did find their names. I have no doubt but that they would
both profit thereby. So if you just send me their names I shall be glad to
do that for you and for them.

Wishing you and yours God's blessing again for a happy day of national
Thanksgiving; and especially in case you do not in the mean time hear from
me again, the grace of a blessed and happy Christmas celebration with all
success for the coming New Year and thereafter. Sincerely Yours in Christ.
